# capability-element-usermedia-legacy

This virtual suite runs tests with legacy PEPC features enabled. Specifically,
it enables `UserMediaElement`, and `UserMediaElementLegacy` features to test
backward compatibility of the `<usermedia>` element.

Test folder:
`wpt_internal/html/semantics/permission-element/usermedia/legacy-mode`
